## Context / Problem
`.github/llm-providers/README.md:3-5` says each `REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE` provider overlay sets `only` `[llm.model_classes]`, repoints the 3 model classes, and changes nothing else. `.github/llm-providers/README.md:11-13` says `tests/unit/test_ci_provider_matrix.py` fails if an overlay sets anything outside `[llm.model_classes]`. Those statements no longer match the current tree.

The committed overlays contain exactly one top-level `[llm]` table with both a scalar `model` and a nested `model_classes` table: `.github/llm-providers/openai.toml:8-14`, `.github/llm-providers/anthropic.toml:8-14`, and `.github/llm-providers/bedrock.toml:14-20`. The scalar `llm.model` is load-bearing because callers can resolve `cfg.model` outside the class table; the overlay comments record that rationale at `.github/llm-providers/openai.toml:5-7`, `.github/llm-providers/anthropic.toml:5-7`, and `.github/llm-providers/bedrock.toml:10-12`.

The parser path also differs from the README wording: `src/rebar/_config_sources.py:238-248` reads the pointed file's `[llm]` table and deep-merges it into discovered configuration. The enforcement in `tests/unit/test_ci_provider_matrix.py:134-147` asserts the top-level key set is exactly `{"llm"}`, the nested `[llm]` key set is exactly `{"model", "model_classes"}`, `llm.model` is provider-qualified for the matrix arm, and `model_classes` covers every class slot.

## Approach
Update `.github/llm-providers/README.md` to describe the actual overlay schema and the actual matrix enforcement. Retain the README's deep-merge, provider isolation, local-use, credential, and verified-model guidance. Workflow comment remediation remains owned by `sphalerite-bereft-tortoise`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `.github/llm-providers/README.md` removes the claim at lines 3-5 that each overlay sets `only` `[llm.model_classes]` and replaces it with the statement that each overlay contains one top-level `[llm]` table with `model` and `model_classes`.
- [ ] `.github/llm-providers/README.md` explains that scalar `llm.model` is required because callers can resolve `cfg.model` outside class slots, matching the overlay rationale in `.github/llm-providers/openai.toml:5-7`, `.github/llm-providers/anthropic.toml:5-7`, and `.github/llm-providers/bedrock.toml:10-12`.
- [ ] `.github/llm-providers/README.md` replaces the enforcement claim at lines 11-13 with a statement matching `tests/unit/test_ci_provider_matrix.py:134-147`: top-level keys must be exactly `{"llm"}`, `[llm]` keys must be exactly `{"model", "model_classes"}`, `llm.model` must be provider-qualified, and every model class slot must be present.
- [ ] `.github/llm-providers/README.md` keeps the deep-merge description aligned with `src/rebar/_config_sources.py:238-248`, where `REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE` layers the pointed `[llm]` table over discovered settings instead of replacing the entire config.
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make verify` exits 0 after the documentation edit.

## Testing
Run `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make verify` from the repository checkout and land only if it exits 0.
